Opening `/widgets/` with a trailing slash shows the 404 page while `/widgets` works. This is a real bug: the part that matches URLs to pages compares the text exactly and does not ignore the trailing slash (the matcher in the router, `src/router.ts:88`; `/widgets/` returns 404 where 200 is expected). The fix will be tracked in an existing ticket that already covers this concern, so no new ticket was filed (https://github.com/example/widgets/issues/42).
